messages:
elaine: heads up — after the 09:00 canary we started seeing slow chart renders in console for some customers. charts hang ~700-1200ms longer on initial load :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy completed: frontend@2026.3.9 (canary) by jora-deploy — sha abc123
elaine: timeline lines up with that deploy, canary -> prod rollout started at 09:12
jorge: looking at Sentry traces now — majority of added time is in main-thread paint and chunk fetch wait. network waterfall shows a new vendor chunk fetching telemetry-v2.bundle.js (~420kb gz) before chart chunk
tara: telemetry-v2? we swapped that in to get structured events for rollouts UX trials. it pulled in a new date lib and a tiny utils bundle 
kevin: FYI I saw CPU spikes on the client repro: flame shows long parse time right when telemetry-v2 runs, and charts (recharts) init is delayed until the chunk finishes
olga: kv-cache miss rate bumped too around the same time — prefetch logic was changed in the same PR to deprioritize background prefetches when route policy is cost-first. maybe prefetch isn't warming chart chunks anymore
elaine: stack snippet from a user trace: "GET /static/js/telemetry-v2.bundle.js 200 423kb 120ms
parseAndCompile (main-thread) 240ms
hydrateChart 380ms"
jorge: possible fixes: 1) revert telemetry-v2 import to dynamic import w/ prefetch hint 2) force vendor split so charts chunk loads earlier 3) tweak prefetch priority flag in rollout config
tara: prefer not to revert the telemetry change — it's needed for the new rollout gating. can we do a targeted split + low-priority preload for telemetry so it doesn't block chart vendor?
kevin: quick experiment: change webpack to split telemetry into its own async chunk and add "rel=preload" for charts vendor. locally that moves chart parsing earlier by ~350ms
olga: also we should revert the prefetch deprioritization for routes serving dashboards — that's what increased kv-cache misses. policy had a blanket rule: cost-tier -> deprioritize prefetch. we can add a whitelist: route.startsWith('/console') => keep prefetch priority
elaine: agree, whitelist console routes. can someone open a hotfix PR for the split + whitelist? we can patch canary and stop prod rollout until validated
jorge: opened PR #4612 — webpack split + preload change. also added config tweak: rollout.policy.prefetchWhitelist = ['^/console']
deploy-bot: rollout paused: frontend@2026.3.9 — pausing production rollout due to perf regression (requested by elaine)
tara: i'll validate with a canary cluster after PR merged. will run perf harness and check KV cache hit ratio + LCP/Lag metrics
kevin: if canary looks good we can re-enable telemetry-v2 import as dynamic with /* webpackChunkName: "telemetry-v2" */ and add link rel=preload for chart-vendor
elaine: thanks — keeping this thread for updates. if anyone sees unusual client errors (TypeError from telemetry hooks) ping here immediately
jorge: merged and canary deployed. initial canary results: LCP improved ~280ms, KV cache hit returned to baseline, no new console errors in Sentry after 12m
olga: monitoring for 30m, will rollback if we see more than 5% regression on p95 render
elaine: perfect. once stable let's add an entry to the rollout playbook: "avoid blocking telemetry imports on critical render paths" and note the prefetch whitelist rule
kevin: filed doc PR #89 for playbook note
elaine: thanks team :thumbsup:
